part.text:
All checks pass. Summary of the fix (mirrors upstream Preact PR #4436):

- **`src/diff/index.js:2811`** (`TreeCoordinator.prototype.applyRef`): when a function ref is invoked, if a previously-stored cleanup (`ref._unmount`) exists it is invoked first; when detaching (`value == null`) the cleanup is called instead of calling `ref(null)`. Otherwise the ref is called and any returned function is stored as `ref._unmount` cleanup.
- **`src/internal.d.ts:129`** and **`src/index.d.ts:41`**: `RefCallback` may now return `void | (() => void)`.

Validation: both new ref-cleanup tests pass (`should call ref cleanup on unmount`, `should call ref cleanup when ref changes`); the full karma suite shows 61 failures, all pre-existing (baseline has the same 61 plus these 2), and `tsc` type checks are clean.
